feeds.title: Your decorative painting resource
feeds.description: In this blog, your decorative painting and tole painting questions answered. You'll paint it better. Learn new techniques, try new products. It's fun, informative and unforgettable.

feeds.title: Glass Painting Blog
feeds.description: Everything you need to know about Glass Painting. This blog covers tutorials, free designs, reviews, and projects. Easy to follow for glass painters of all abilities.

feeds.title: Kinghorn Glass Studio
feeds.description: Hi! I am Carole Robinson. I work intuitively combining literary elements with ornate layers, each detail inspired by travel and nature. I am intrigued by warm glass techniques and have a profound interest in primitive mark-making. I am dedicated to exploring traditional and contemporary methods, hence my recent focus on fused, enameled and painted glass.

feeds.title: The Questions of Glass Painting Blog
feeds.description: Williams & Byrne are designers, painters, and restorers of stained glass. Now preparing the full-sized designs for new windows in a castle.

feeds.title: Glass paint by Glassprimer Blog
feeds.description: Glass paint is a specialty coating that's designed to bond directly to glass surfaces such as glass tabletops, back-splashes, and counter-tops. Glass Paint Blog is your source for the latest happenings in the Glass Paint world

feeds.title: . debora coombs . artblog
feeds.description: Debora Coombs award-winning stained glass is exhibited, commissioned and collected internationally. She now uses classic art and design skills, medieval craftsmanship, and the laws of mathematics to explore geometry, using art like physics, to investigate the nature of space and time.

feeds.title: The Glass Painter's Method
feeds.description: All about the brushes, paints and tools of traditional kiln-fired stained glass painting, with special attention for techniques and how you can adapt them to your own ends. New material every two weeks.
